r.notes: A koala (can't be sure if it's the same one) has come to this tree (and other trees nearby) regularly for at least 20 years
Koala appeared healthy, chaperoned into reserve, very nearly hit by several cars, was moving from residential area when spotted
I did not see the Koala's, However heard Two Males mating calls. I hear them every now and again
Was a healthy animal. If not for the koala friendly fence it would have been trapped by the road side.
Reported to KAG by phone call from resident Ruth KnightShe was concerned that neighbour property where koala was sighted is going to be subdivded resulting in removal of numerous koala trees
Sitting up in a tree in nature strip. Across the road from park easement
Heard him grunting while I was hanging out the washing
It was grunting loudly, and only about 7m off the ground
Emailed to KAGHeard him around for a week
Grunting alerted us to his location
Male has been in yard and surrounding area for past several months.  Several euccs planted by Pam approx 20 years ago.
A regular male is in the area but this female is new
Reported to KAG phone by elderly person with concerns for koala
This is the first time I have been to this park so I'm not sure how many koalas are in the area
healthy male, clear eyes. we managed to get him off the road into the next property without dogs
Elise Parups and I saw the koala  and then we returned with a camera.The koala seemed young, healthy and alert.This is the second time we have observed koalas in this area in the past 2 years.
